# Take Quiz

## Summary
Records a Quiz Attempt with answers; score is derived by the attempt.

## Refuses when
enrolment not active; attempts exhausted; time limit exceeded.

## Non-goals
Business rules beyond those listed belong to the consumer.

## Example
The linked attempt is what one run of the command writes.
attributes.cardDescription: Records a quiz attempt with its answers, refusing when attempts are used up or the time limit has passed.
